label: Task-23
title: Use messages panel for confirmation dialogs instead of browser alerts
description:
Replace native browser `confirm()` dialogs with inline confirmation UI in the messages panel.

## Current Problem
When deleting a node, we show:
```
0.0.0.0:10041 says
Delete Task-18? This cannot be undone.
[Cancel] [OK]
```

This has several issues:
1. Shows ugly IP address header
2. Blocks the entire UI
3. No styling consistency
4. Can't be reviewed later
5. Poor UX on mobile

## Proposed Solution
Show confirmations as special messages in the messages panel:

```
[Messages Panel]

⚠️ CONFIRM DELETE
Delete Task-18? This cannot be undone.
[Cancel] [Delete]
```

## Implementation

### 1. Add confirmation message type to messages-service.js
```javascript
messages.confirm('Delete Task-18? This cannot be undone.', {
  confirmLabel: 'Delete',
  confirmStyle: 'danger',
  onConfirm: () => deleteNode('Task-18'),
  onCancel: () => {}
});
```

### 2. Update messages-panel.js
- Render confirmation messages with action buttons
- Auto-expand panel for confirmations
- Focus the confirm/cancel buttons
- Remove message after action taken

### 3. Update node-detail.js delete handler
```javascript
// Old
if (confirm('Delete ' + label + '? This cannot be undone.')) {
  await this.deleteNode();
}

// New
window.issuesApp.messages.confirm(
  `Delete ${label}? This cannot be undone.`,
  { onConfirm: () => this.deleteNode() }
);
```

## Benefits
- Consistent styling with app theme
- Non-blocking (can still see context)
- Recorded in message history
- Better mobile experience
- Can add more context/details to confirmation
